persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Carol, 72, in Ohio. Your grandson just set up your first smartphone. You keep hearing about “AI” on the TV news, and last week someone sent you a text asking for money, so you are wary of scams. Today you sit down with a cup of coffee and take the AI course, one lesson at a time.

challenge.intro: Now you are Carol, taking the course yourself. The course is empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press. Use what you learned. If the teacher asks for a name, type Carol. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Open Daraja Academy with the normal link (not the 🧪 test copy). If the welcome tour shows, tap 'skip the tour' → '✨ Start fresh with my own' → OK. If a menu asking 'What would you like to do?' covers the page, tap '↩ Pick up where I left off' first. Then scroll to the very bottom of the page and tap '🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data' → OK → OK. The bar says '0 of 6 lessons done' and no card has a ✅.

tasks.text: Finish lesson 1, all the way to the end, including its quiz.
tasks.hint: A lesson only counts when you reach its last page, after the quiz. Look for a ✅ on the lesson 1 card.

tasks.text: You want to know how to keep strawberries fresh for a whole week. In lesson 1, put your real question where the lesson asks for one.
tasks.hint: Lesson 1 has a page called 'Now ask something REAL'. Type your question in the box there. You do not need to open ChatGPT.

tasks.text: You are wary of scams. Finish the lesson that teaches how to spot a fake message.
tasks.hint: Lesson 2 is 'Spot the fake'. Answer all five messages, then the quiz, then reach the last page.

tasks.text: You want AI to help you write a funny birthday note to your granddaughter. Build that request in the lesson about writing.
tasks.hint: Lesson 5, 'Let it write with you', has a page where you tap who it is to, what it is for, and how it should sound.

tasks.text: Finish that writing lesson, all the way to the end.
tasks.hint: Keep tapping the green button through lesson 5, answer its quiz, and reach the page that says Lesson 5 done.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: a short course that teaches older people to use AI
how to ask AI questions and let it help you write
how to spot fakes and scams and check answers

subs: How can I keep sukuma wiki fresh for three days without a fridge?
How can I keep strawberries fresh for a whole week?
how do I plant sukuma wiki

lines: This video explains Daraja Academy from the very beginning. If you have never seen it, that is fine.
First, the problem. Everyone is talking about A I. That means artificial intelligence: programs like ChatGPT or Claude that answer questions and write, much the way a person would.
Young people pick these tools up quickly. Many grandparents feel left behind, or a little afraid. And there are new scams: a cheat can now copy a voice and send messages that look real.
Daraja Academy is a short course called A I for Grandparents. Six lessons, about ten minutes each. Big words, one idea at a time, and nothing you do can break anything.
It is for older people who want to understand A I, and often a grandchild sitting beside them. It also makes a lovely gift.
This is the course home. The green note is your teacher. The first time, it asks your first name. Type it and tap That's me.
Under the teacher, this bar shows how many of the six lessons are finished.
Then the lesson cards: number, name and minutes. The one outlined in gold is next. Tap a card to open it.
At the bottom, a wide card for the diploma. It opens when all six lessons are done.
Now, inside a lesson. Each page has one idea in big words. The dots at the top show how far along you are.
Read this page to me reads the page out loud. Tap it again to stop.
At the bottom, the green button goes forward. It says Next, or something like I'm ready. The white button goes back.
Lesson one is Just ask it. It teaches the only rule: talk to it like a person, the way you'd ask a neighbor.
Then you practice on a safe practice A I that lives inside the lesson. Tap a question, and its answer appears underneath.
Then, Now ask something real. Type your own question. Copy my question copies it, and two buttons open ChatGPT or Claude with it already typed in.
Then the safety rule: a real A I helper never calls you and never asks for money.
Every lesson ends with a one-question quiz. Tap A, B or C. Green shows the right answer, with the reason why. Then tap Finish the lesson.
Lesson two, Spot the fake: messages appear one at a time. For each, tap Fake or Real, and it tells you why.
Lesson three, Ask it better: tap the follow-ups and watch the answer change to suit you.
Lesson four, Trust, but check: for each answer, decide whether to check it first or just use it.
Lesson five, Let it write with you: tap who it's to, what it's for, and how it should sound, and the request writes itself.
Lesson six, A I in your pocket: talking instead of typing, showing it a picture, and putting it on your phone's front screen.
Stop in the middle, and it opens on the same page next time. Finished lessons get a tick on the course home.
Finish all six, and this card opens your diploma, with your name and the date, ready to print.
Your first ten minutes: type your first name, tap Start lesson one, and go page by page. You'll finish having asked an A I your very first question.
Privacy: everything stays on this device. No account and no password. Nothing you type is sent anywhere, unless you choose to take your question to ChatGPT or Claude yourself.
The price: lesson one is free, and the whole course is nineteen dollars.
And the question mark button in the corner has the tour, bigger text and help, any time.

daily.task: Do one more part of a lesson in Daraja Academy, or answer one quiz question.

explore.name: 🏠 Course home
explore.try: Give the teacher a name (try empty, then very long). Look at the lesson cards and the diploma card.

explore.name: 📖 Inside a lesson
explore.try: Tap Read this page to me, then stop it. Go forward and back. Turn the phone sideways.

explore.name: 💬 Practice pages
explore.try: Tap the questions. In Ask something real, type a question, Copy my question. Look at the ChatGPT / Claude buttons.

explore.name: ✅ The quiz
explore.try: Pick a wrong answer first, then the right one. Finish the lesson.

explore.name: 🚩 Lesson 2 · Spot the fake
explore.try: Mark all five messages Fake or Real. Get one wrong on purpose.

explore.name: 🔍 Lessons 3 & 4
explore.try: Tap the follow-ups in lesson 3. In lesson 4 choose “Check it first” or “Just use it” for each.

explore.name: ✍️ Lesson 5 · Write with you
explore.try: Tap who it is to, what it is for, and how it should sound. Read the request it writes.

explore.name: 📱 Lesson 6 · AI in your pocket
explore.try: Go through every page and every button.

explore.name: 🎓 The diploma
explore.find: The wide card at the bottom of home.
explore.try: Open it. Tap Print my diploma (cancel). Look at Send a friend — don’t send.

explore.name: ❓ The round ? button
explore.find: Tap the round ? in the bottom corner.
explore.try: Open every line in it: Aa (size), ✨ Ask an AI, 🌉 More from Daraja, 🎬 Take the tour again. Close it. Leave “Start fresh” for the very end.
